messages:
emma: Heads-up: planned autoscaler-controller upgrade + warmup load tonight 02:00 UTC. Window 40m. This is a rolling controller change that may transiently reduce autoscaling responsiveness for ~10m.

frank: Summary: controller v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 (improves pod eviction handling). We'll run a warmup traffic generator to keep model backends hot while controllers reconcile. Expect occasional short scaling delays, not full outages.

lucy: Canary plan: 01:50 start 0.5% warmup generator to exercise KV priming and prefix cache. If stable, ramp to 3% at 01:58.

emma: Runbook highlights:
```
- 01:40 pause non-critical batch jobs
- 01:50 start warmup generator (0.5%)
- 02:00 apply autoscaler controller upgrade to control-plane nodes (rolling)
- 02:05 watch pod restart / evictions / desired vs actual replicas
- 02:10 if stable, increase warmup to 3% to exercise batching
- 02:25 start controller health-check validation and latency sweep
- 02:30 rollback if 5xx > 0.7% for 5m or p95 > 600ms for 5m
```

frank: SLO note: availability SLO will be temporarily annotated and relaxed from 99.95% -> 99.7% for the maintenance window. This is availability (error budget) only; latency SLOs remain as-is. We'll add an annotation to SLO history and incident rollups.

infra-bot: scheduled-maintenance created: id mnt-1810, start 1786348800, end 1786351200 1 see /maint mnt-1810

lucy: Alerts to watch: `autoscaler-sync-latency`, `pod-eviction-rate`, `model-kv-cache-hit`, `edge-5xx-rate`. I'm adding a temporary pager if 5xx > 0.7% for 5m.

emma: Warmup command (will run from ops box):
```
for i in {1..250}; do curl -sS "$WARMUP_CANARY/warm?model=quant_small" >/dev/null; done
```

frank: Cost note: warmup generates a small token cost (~$30) for the window; expected net savings since controllers should reduce unnecessary cold starts afterwards.

lucy: Risk note: services that pin minReplicas to 0 could see a few-second cold start. If you own such a service, consider bumping minReplicas to 1 temporarily.

emma: If anyone sees sustained errors or p95 latency regressions, start rollback immediately and ping #incidents and @oncall.

oncall-bot: reminder: oncall rotation for maintenance: @emma primary, @lucy secondary for 01:30-03:30 UTC

frank: I'll be monitoring dashboards and will post the first canary metrics in-thread at 01:55.

lucy: ack

emma: ack 1 posting a short template for the maintenance notes/postmortem here after the window.
